notes.title: First Strike 7 Year Anniversary Remaster Update
notes.content:
Hello all fans of Blindflug Studios

First Strike, the nuclear war game, which was also the game that founded our studio, will have a major milestone this week: It is turning seven years old!

To celebrate, we gave it a special treatment as a game: it got a complete remaster. The new First Strike is faster, sleeker and more cunning, but still has the old bombastic gameplay that made it such a hit for us.

Check it out, we also have a nice discount going for its celebration as well as a livestream on Saturday 13th of March on 7PM CET.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/587000/First_Strike_Final_Hour/]Check out First Strike: Classic[/url]

So Happy Birthday First Strike! Never stop nuking the world!
